rows.text: The symbol with several bumps means uneven road: it warns that the road surface is irregular.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The uneven road sign warns that the roadway may be damaged or in poor condition.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The red-bordered triangle warns of a hazard: here, an uneven road.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
DPR 495/1992, art. 84: segnali di pericolo, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The sign indicates an uneven road, not a steep descent: it warns of an irregular surface.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The bumps represent an uneven road surface; dangerous bends have a different sign.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
DPR 495/1992, art. 86: segnali di curve pericolose, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The symbol indicates an uneven road; a double bend has a different sign.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
DPR 495/1992, art. 86: segnali di curve pericolose, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The uneven surface can make vehicles coming from the opposite direction harder to control too, so anticipate possible deviations.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
Codice della strada, art. 141, commi 1–3: velocità commisurata alle condizioni della strada e alla visibilità, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-141/

rows.text: The sign warns of an uneven surface: slowing down helps you maintain control.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
Codice della strada, art. 141, commi 1–3: velocità commisurata alle condizioni della strada e alla visibilità, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-141/

rows.text: On an uneven surface, jolts can affect steering: a firm but relaxed grip helps you control the handlebars.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: An uneven surface calls for an appropriate, cautious speed, not an increase in speed.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
Codice della strada, art. 141, commi 1–3: velocità commisurata alle condizioni della strada e alla visibilità, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-141/

rows.text: Do not reduce the gap: leave enough room to stop without hitting the vehicle ahead.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
Codice della strada, art. 149, comma 1: distanza sufficiente per arrestarsi evitando collisioni, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-149/

rows.text: The sign warns of an uneven surface and does not require you to stop for every oncoming vehicle; proceed cautiously.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
Codice della strada, art. 141, commi 1–3: velocità commisurata alle condizioni della strada e alla visibilità, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-141/

rows.text: The crest sign is a warning sign: it is normally placed 150 metres before the hazard.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
Camera di commercio di Torino, Materiale informativo per esame taxi, segnale dosso: distanza normalmente 150 metri, https://www.to.camcom.it/sites/default/files/imprese-artigiane/manualetaxi.pdf

rows.text: A crest is a convex change in the road that can hide what lies beyond its top.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: A crest is an uphill section followed by a descent: its top restricts your view of the road beyond.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
Camera di commercio di Torino, Materiale informativo per esame taxi, segnale dosso: salita seguita da discesa, https://www.to.camcom.it/sites/default/files/imprese-artigiane/manualetaxi.pdf

rows.text: The single hump indicates a crest that limits visibility; an uneven road has a different symbol.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: This is the crest sign, indicating a convex change in the road; it does not mean the surface is damaged.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The symbol indicates a crest with limited visibility; roadworks have a different sign.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
DPR 495/1992, art. 31: segnalamento temporaneo dei lavori, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592

rows.text: The crest restricts your view: slow down so you can stop within the distance you can see.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
Codice della strada, art. 141, commi 1–3: velocità commisurata alle condizioni della strada e alla visibilità, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-141/

rows.text: Visibility is limited at a crest, where making a U-turn is prohibited.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
Codice della strada, art. 154, comma 6: inversione di marcia vietata in prossimità o corrispondenza di dossi, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-154/

rows.text: Visibility is limited at a crest, so a stopped vehicle may be seen too late. Stopping and parking are prohibited on the crest, both uphill and downhill.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
Codice della strada, art. 158, comma 1, lett. c: fermata e sosta vietate sui dossi, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-158/

rows.text: The sign warns of a crest and does not require you to drive in the centre: normally, drive on the right near the edge.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
Codice della strada, art. 143, comma 1: circolazione a destra e vicino al margine destro, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-143/

rows.text: The sign indicates a crest that restricts visibility, not a damaged surface; adapt your driving to what you can see.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
Codice della strada, art. 141, commi 1–3: velocità commisurata alle condizioni della strada e alla visibilità, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-141/

rows.text: Parking is also prohibited on the uphill section of the crest: limited visibility may prevent other drivers from seeing the parked vehicle in time.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
Codice della strada, art. 158, comma 1, lett. c: fermata e sosta vietate sui dossi, https://aci.gov.it/codice-della-strada/art-158/

rows.text: The symbol with a concave profile indicates a dip, a depression in the road.
evidence: DPR 495/1992, art. 85, commi 1–3: definisce i segnali di strada deformata, dosso e cunetta, https://olympus.uniurb.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=15022:dpr49592
